summary: The test compiles and uses Playwright APIs correctly. The testCaseId is preserved in the test title. The selector uses a data-test attribute which is acceptable, but the navigation URL assertion uses a generic regex which is not strong enough to fully verify the product detail page. The test lacks assertion verifying content on the product detail page, which weakens validation strength.

issues.description: The URL assertion uses a generic regex (/product/) that is too weak to conclusively confirm navigation to the exact product detail page.
issues.recommendation: Use a more precise URL assertion or add assertions to verify specific elements or content unique to the selected product detail page.

issues.description: No assertion verifies presence of product information on the product detail page beyond URL check.
issues.recommendation: Add assertions to check key elements on the product detail page, such as product title, description, or price.

recommendations: Improve the URL assertion to be more specific to the selected product page.
Include content assertions verifying essential product details are displayed.
Keep using data-test attributes for selectors for stability.
